items.title: Scottish court dismisses £20,000 motor claim after finding widespread fraud indicators
items.summary: First Central Insurance Management successfully defended a £20,000 personal injury and vehicle damage claim after a Scottish court uncovered odometer tampering and undisclosed connected parties.

items.title: Starr confirms new underwriting and claims leadership across International and London divisions
items.summary: Starr has announced an immediate leadership structure for its International and London divisions to support cross-market collaboration and underwriting discipline.

items.title: Scotland's appeal court caps credit hire bill after driver ignores insurer's free vehicle offer
items.summary: Scotland's Sheriff Appeal Court has adopted the English Copley v Lawn framework, ruling that a motorist acted unreasonably by ignoring an insurer's intervention letter.

items.title: Alvarez and Marsal analysis warns up to £8bn in retail sales at risk
items.summary: Lower consumer confidence threatens up to £8bn of retail sales during the Black Friday and Christmas trading period, according to Alvarez and Marsal analysis.

items.title: Professional Pensions sets date and venue for 2027 Admin and Data Forum
items.summary: The Professional Pensions Admin and Data Forum 2027 will take place in London on Thursday 4 March.

items.title: Department for Work and Pensions takes services offline following cyber incident
items.summary: The Department for Work and Pensions suspended online benefit services on Friday after detecting suspicious activity.
